hierarchy.label: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-primary

typography.alignment: Strictly Left-aligned for maximum readability. No center alignment for dense text. Headings can be left-aligned.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neo-Brutalist High-Contrast. Use hard solid shadows (e.g. `shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#FFFFFF]`) on interactive elements. No soft blurs. Borders must be `border-2` or `border-4` solid white or primary color to ensure maximum visibility.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react. Minimum size 48px (`size={48}`). Icons MUST always be paired with explicit, highly visible text labels. Stroke width should be 2.5 or 3 for maximum visibility.
visual_enhancers.hover_active_states: Invert colors on hover/active. E.g., a white button with black text becomes black with white border and white text. Active states must physically move the button (`translate-x-[4px] translate-y-[4px] shadow-none`).

grids.home_modules: grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:gap-8 w-full max-w-2xl mx-auto
grids.camera_placeholder: w-full aspect-[3/4] md:aspect-video border-4 border-dashed border-primary flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-surface p-8

layouts.header: fixed top-0 w-full h-24 border-b-4 border-white bg-black z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-6. MUST contain the LIVO logo and a massive voice-assistance (Mic) button.
layouts.main_content: flex-1 overflow-y-auto mt-24 mb-32 p-6 md:p-12 space-y-8
layouts.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full h-32 border-t-4 border-white bg-black z-50 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 px-2 py-4. Nav items must be huge, flex-col, icon + text.

motion.transitions: Snappy and instantaneous. Use `transition-all duration-75`. Avoid long sweeping animations as they can be disorienting for visually impaired users.
motion.interactions: Physical click feel (Neo-brutalist translate on active).

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AAA. Text over backgrounds must have extreme contrast (Black/White/Yellow).
accessibility.touch_targets: MINIMUM 80x80px for any tappable area. Main module buttons should be at least 140px tall.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have `focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-4 focus:ring-offset-black`.
accessibility.screen_readers: Use `aria-label` where visual text isn't descriptive enough, though the design requires all text to be fully descriptive visually. Add `role="button"` to actionable elements.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, nav item, and placeholder must have a `data-testid`.

media.strategy: No complex background images or gradients. Stick to stark, high-contrast solid colors to maximize text visibility and cognitive ease.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react for bold, thick icons.
Install react-router-dom for simple client-side routing between the 4 screens.
Ensure `react-router-dom` is used to manage the Views: Home, Bill Checker, Cash Assistant, Change Checker.
Build the UI in React (.jsx or .js if no typescript, but stick to functional components).

IMPLEMENT A FIXED HEADER: Black bg, solid white border bottom, holding LIVO logo and a massive 'Mic' button (Voice Assistance) with `data-testid='voice-assist-btn'`. Mic button should be bright Yellow (#FFD600) with Black icon.
IMPLEMENT A FIXED BOTTOM NAV: 3 items (Bill, Cash, Change). Extremely large touch areas. Active state should be highlighted with Yellow text/icon and a top border.
HOME SCREEN: Large typography tagline 'See. Verify. Pay. Independently.'. Three massive vertical block buttons for the modules.
MODULE SCREENS: Use a dashed thick border container for the 'Camera/Upload/Scan' placeholders. Add huge solid buttons below them.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards with subtle shadows. Use raw Tailwind to create Brutalist, high-contrast blocks.
Always pair icons with text. Never rely on an icon alone.
Do NOT center align paragraphs. Left align for readability. Headings can be left aligned.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize optical clarity and massive scale over subtle aesthetics.
Never use grey text. Only White, Black, or Bright Yellow.
Never use `transparent` backgrounds for headers or footers if content scrolls underneath; use solid #000000.
Avoid `transition: all`. Be specific, e.g., `transition-transform transition-colors`.
DO NOT implement actual camera/AI logic. Just visual layout and navigation.
